corrections.field_01: Strongest feature: Horn coherently integrates Pauline transformed-body terminology, Jewish resurrection expectations, corporeal eating, ghost-denial, and empty-tomb narration into a unified explanation that directly answers the proposed disembodied interpretation. Principal limitation: His reconciliation leaves barrier-crossing and untouchability episodes comparatively underdeveloped, while treating Jewish contextual probability as more terminologically determinative than Pauline and Gospel ambiguity warrants. Live burden: The defense must explicitly demonstrate why extraordinary post-resurrection capacities remain compatible with numerical bodily continuity, and why competing construals cannot accommodate the same textual combination without weakening explanatory discrimination. Locked score: This remains a very strong, substantially responsive reply because its cumulative contextual architecture and concrete embodied indicators materially advance the central bodily-appearances burden, notwithstanding implicit qualification and incompletely resolved narrative tensions.
corrections.field_02: Strongest feature: Horn carefully distinguishes the occurrence of a non-Christian wonder from wholesale endorsement of the beneficiary’s religious system, presenting a coherent, explicitly limited theological possibility with representational charity. Principal limitation: That distinction supplies relevant supernaturalist background but never evaluates Mormon witness testimony, establishes comparative criteria, or answers whether evidentially similar reports require methodologically consistent treatment. Live burden: The reply must confront testimonial parity by identifying differences in witness quality, corroboration, explanatory alternatives, or doctrinal implications, rather than showing that Christianity can accommodate religiously external miracles. Locked score: This is a strong, logically precise subsidiary contribution whose calibrated example advances supernatural admissibility, yet its argumentative usefulness remains constrained because the decisive rival-witness comparison receives no substantive contact.
